units.source_text: 八月中旬，野外秋色正美之时，夕雾渴望看看公主山居情状，

en.t: In the middle of the eighth month, when the autumn colors in the countryside were at their loveliest, Yugiri longed to see how the princess was living in her mountain retreat,

units.source_text: 便装作普通访友的样子，对云居雁说：

en.t: so he pretended that he was merely going to visit an ordinary friend and said to Kumoinokari:

units.source_text: “某某律师难得下山，我有要事和他商谈。

en.t: “A certain Buddhist preceptor has rarely come down from the mountain, and I have important matters to discuss with him.

units.source_text: 老夫人患病在山，我也想乘便前往慰问。”

en.t: The elderly lady is ill in the mountains, and I would also like to take the opportunity to call on her and offer my sympathy.”

units.source_text: 便向小野出发了。

en.t: With that, he set out for Ono.

units.source_text: 随从人员不多，只带亲信五六人，都穿便服。

en.t: He did not take many attendants, only five or six trusted men, all dressed informally.

units.source_text: 一路上山道并不特别深僻，惟松崎地方山色颇佳，

en.t: Along the way the mountain road was not especially remote, but around Matsuzaki the mountain scenery was quite beautiful,

units.source_text: 虽无奇岩怪石，而秋色十分娇艳。

en.t: and though there were no strange cliffs or fantastic rocks, the autumn colors were wonderfully vivid.

units.source_text: 比较起都中富丽无匹的宫邸来，毕竟富有清趣，更饶雅兴。

en.t: Compared with the matchlessly splendid mansions in the capital, it had a fresher charm and an even more elegant appeal.

units.source_text: 落叶公主的别墅围着低低的柴垣，却也别饶趣致。

en.t: Princess Ochiba’s villa was surrounded by a low brushwood fence, which gave it its own special grace.

units.source_text: 虽是暂住之处，气象实甚高雅。

en.t: Although it was only a temporary residence, its atmosphere was truly refined.

units.source_text: 作为正厅的房间东面凸出的一室内，筑着一座祈祷坛。

en.t: In a room projecting from the east side of the chamber that served as the main hall, a prayer altar had been set up.

units.source_text: 老夫人住在北厢，落叶公主住在西面的室中。

en.t: The elderly lady stayed in the northern wing, while Princess Ochiba occupied a room on the west side.

units.source_text: 当初老夫人说鬼怪不祥，公主不可同行。

en.t: At first the elderly lady had said that the spirit was ominous and that the princess must not accompany her.

units.source_text: 但公主哪里肯离开母亲！

en.t: But how could the princess possibly agree to leave her mother?

units.source_text: 必欲追随入山。

en.t: She was determined to follow her into the mountains.

units.source_text: 老夫人又恐鬼怪移到别人身上，故将居室稍稍隔离，

en.t: The elderly lady also feared that the spirit might move onto someone else, so she kept her living quarters somewhat separated,

units.source_text: 和公主的房间不通。

en.t: with no passage connecting them to the princess’s room.

units.source_text: 因为没有招待客人的房间，几个上等侍女便引导夕雾来到公主帘前，

en.t: Since there was no room for receiving guests, several senior ladies-in-waiting led Yugiri to the front of the princess’s curtain,

units.source_text: 请他暂待，然后向老夫人通报。

en.t: asked him to wait there for a while, and then announced his arrival to the elderly lady.

units.source_text: 老夫人命侍女传言：“承蒙远道劳驾，盛情不胜感激。

en.t: The elderly lady had an attendant convey her words: “I am deeply grateful that you have taken the trouble to come such a long way.

units.source_text: 老身如果就此死去，无法报答公子大德，如今幸得苟延残喘。”

en.t: If this old body had died as it was, I could never have repaid your great kindness, but fortunately I have managed to cling to life until now.”

units.source_text: 夕雾答道：“尊驾移居之时，小生本当亲送，

en.t: Yugiri replied: “When Your Ladyship moved here, I should by rights have escorted you myself,

units.source_text: 只因家父正有要事嘱办，以致不克如愿。

en.t: but my father had just entrusted me with an important matter, and so I was unable to do as I wished.

units.source_text: 此后又因杂务烦忙，一时未能造访，中心不胜悬念。

en.t: After that, various duties kept me busy, and for a time I could not visit, though I was deeply anxious in my heart.

units.source_text: 多所怠慢，不胜歉憾。”

en.t: I have been remiss in many ways, and I regret it more than I can say.”
